known_secrets.text: Administrative records from the Turning period were deliberately simplified under Tarek's direction.
He ended Elira's formal role but knows she kept private copies of the originals.
He has never confronted Elira about this directly.
He privately doubts his own strategy of managing the town's story rather than telling it plainly.
He suspects the land is still degrading and that his handling has only delayed a reckoning.
Luma knows more of what he buried than anyone else alive, except Elira.

unknowns: Meaning of the Signs on the seals
Whether the town can survive an honest reckoning with the Turning
What Elira's full private archive actually contains
